resources.string: Non-Japanese recognition uses PP-OCRv5. Install the source language model; Chinese supports both scripts. Download or import its official inference.onnx file, verified before use.

Delete the model files for “%1$s” stored in the app?\n\nYou will need to download or import them again to use the corresponding translation features. If this is the current local AI model, its selection will be cleared. Original manga images, saved translations and import source files are kept.
HY-MT1.5 · Multilingual text translation. Set as the current model after download and validation. Other installed models are kept.
HY-MT2 fine-tuned for manga translation · Japanese → Simplified Chinese. Set as the current model after download and validation. Other installed models are kept.
Prepare source and target language packs

This selection is only for downloads and does not change the translation target. Each language uses about 30 MB; English needs no separate pack. The Google SDK supports neither local file imports nor progress in bytes, so a waiting status is shown during downloads. Installed packs can be deleted individually below.
Language pack status is unavailable. Refresh or check downloads again.
Processing; models in use will be handled after the current translation stage releases them…
None selected. Download or import one in “Model management”.
%1$s\nPrepare the selected source and target packs. Chinese uses the shared zh model; English needs no separate pack.
%1$s\nQuality depends on the selected translation model. Try a sample first.
Prepare the selected source and target packs. Chinese uses the shared zh model; English needs no separate pack.
The current target language is unsupported by this engine. Switched to Simplified Chinese.
Automatically translate the current page and the specified number of following pages. Set 0–10 pages.
Text detection, OCR and text removal models are ready. Automatically validated when translation starts.
Delete temporary translated images and unfinished page caches. Saved translations, original images and models are kept.
Save translated images to gallery folder
When translating downloaded galleries or imported local folders, save translation results page by page in the _translated subfolder of the gallery folder.
Delete all saved translated images and translation caches for the %1$d selected galleries? Original images, download records and models are kept.

Download the latest APK from this project’s release channel.

Cannot read the gallery. Translation stopped. Reopen the gallery and retry.
Cannot start the background translation service. Translation stopped. Return to the reader and retry.
Partially complete; missing regions can be translated
This page needs a translated image. Prepare the required models in “Settings → Translation → Model management”. Existing translated images can still be viewed.
Translation failed; original image kept. You can retry this page.
No translatable text found; original image kept
Animated images are not currently translated; original image kept
Use AI to remove the original text and restore the background. When disabled, a faster solid-color fill is used.

OCR text recognition, text removal and typesetting in this process all run on your device. Use a local AI model or ML Kit mode to translate offline.\n\nTap the translation icon at the top of the reader to enable translation. Tap again to show the original image and stop translation. Tap the floating progress panel to show or hide the translation overlay for the current page. Long-press to retranslate the current page, translate the entire gallery or open settings. The current queue continues in the background, but runs more slowly due to Android system restrictions. Full gallery tasks can be stopped from the notification.
Download or import text detection, OCR and text removal models in “Model management”, about 236 MiB. Uninstalling the app deletes the models.
ML Kit offline packs for the current source and target languages are ready
Language packs are not ready. Prepare ML Kit language packs in “Model management”.
Manga models are not ready. Download or import the manga model set in “Model management”.
Current ML Kit language packs are ready. Prepare manga models separately.
Failed to prepare ML Kit language packs. Check network, storage space and the connection to Google downloads, then retry.
Offline models are ready. Return to the reader and tap the translation icon to start.
Models are not ready. Import manga models in “Translation settings → Model management”. ML Kit mode also requires language packs.
Download complete. Validating and loading the model; it will be imported automatically on success. Please wait…
Model download failed: %1$s. Check network, storage space and the connection to Hugging Face downloads, then retry.

Import a single-file GGUF translation or instruction model. It becomes the current model after copying and validation. Other installed models are kept and can be switched or deleted. Small quantized models are recommended; required memory exceeds the file size.
Copying and validating the model. Please wait…
Model imported. Tap “Try a sentence” to check the result.
Manga models are ready. Import a local GGUF translation model separately.
Prepare manga models and a local GGUF translation model in “Model management”.
Translate a sample in the selected source language into the target language. No OCR model required.
Cannot load local translation components. Reinstall the complete arm64 version.
Enter the full OpenAI-compatible HTTP/HTTPS chat/completions endpoint. For a PC on your LAN, use its IP address or hostname. 127.0.0.1 refers to this phone.
Enter a full HTTP or HTTPS URL. It must not contain a username, password or fragment.
Enter the model ID provided by the service. Leave blank if the service supports a default model; cloud services usually require it.
Leave blank if your local service requires no authentication. For cloud services, enter the provider’s key.
Translate a sample in the selected source language into the target language. No OCR model required.
OCR and text removal models are ready. Tap “Check service and try translation” to verify the API.
View translation timings for this page
No translation timings recorded for this reading session. Pages loaded directly from cache are not timed again. Choose “Retranslate this page” to record timings.

Full page: %1$.1f s
Detection: %2$.1f s
OCR: %3$.1f s
Text translation: %4$.1f s
Text removal: %5$.1f s
Typesetting: %6$.1f s

When completed OCR / text removal is reused, that stage is recorded as 0 s. Text removal and translation may overlap, so stage times do not add up to the full page time. Full page time excludes original image downloads and writing translated images to cache. In local mode, model loading time is included in each stage.
Choose the language of the original. Recognition depends on fonts and image quality. Saved images are kept when languages change; retranslate the current page to update them.
This model is fine-tuned for Japanese → Simplified Chinese. For other pairs, select or import a multilingual model in Model management.

The first page uses manga OCR to identify the gallery language. For non-Japanese, the matching PP-OCRv5 model rereads this page and handles subsequent pages; install that model first. The decision lasts for this task. Short or mixed text is retried on the next page; manual selection takes priority.
Cannot reliably identify the source. Select a language manually before using ML Kit.
Auto prepares Japanese, Korean, Chinese and the target language packs. English needs no separate pack.
